questions.question: What shape is used in a flowchart to represent a decision?

points.text: A diamond shape is used to represent a decision in a flowchart.

questions.question: Write pseudo-code that asks the user for a number and outputs "Even" if it is divisible by 2, or "Odd" if it is not.

points.text: INPUT number IF number MOD 2 = 0 THEN OUTPUT "Even" ELSE OUTPUT "Odd" ENDIF

questions.question: Explain the difference between decomposition and abstraction.

points.text: Decomposition breaks a complex problem into smaller sub-problems that can be solved independently. Abstraction removes unnecessary detail so you can focus on what is essential to solve the problem.

questions.question: A program needs to calculate the area of a rectangle. Identify the inputs, processing and outputs.

points.text: Inputs: length and width of the rectangle. Processing: multiply length by width. Output: the area of the rectangle.

questions.question: Decompose the problem of creating an online shopping system into at least four sub-problems.

points.text: Sub-problems: 1) Browse/search products, 2) Add items to basket, 3) Process payment, 4) Manage delivery details, 5) Handle user accounts.
